how: Each document is _governed_text('norms', effect) (tests/test_scope_document.py) with: dup-uN, unit uN copied to the end; adj-uN, copied beside itself; noid2-uN, two copies of uN without an id; noid-own-u1u2, u1 and u2 without their ids; noid-empty, two units {}. Old answers: `lake env lean --run` of a scratch copy of readSplit and checkDocSets over decodeBlock without its firstDup line, on `commit`; an ok answer was then given to ROWS['scope'] and scope.read_answer. New: VE.Scope.Run.explainCase and checkDocSets on `commit`. Each of the six effects' documents without a fault answered ok on both routes, old and new.
